You will create an app that determines a persons access based on:

Height → Age → Adult supervision

items.description:
---------------------------------------------
Code Cleanup Crew — Multiple-Choice Questions
---------------------------------------------

Directions: Compare the BEFORE and AFTER code. Choose the best answer.

# BEFORE
price1 = 20
tax1 = price1 * .06
price2 = 40
tax2 = price2 * .06
price3 = 100
tax3 = price3 * .06

# AFTER
def calculate_tax(price):
    return price * .06

print(calculate_tax(20))
print(calculate_tax(40))
print(calculate_tax(100))
